From Impression to Appointment.A Content-Driven, Intent Strategy

DATIA brings buyer identification, cross-channel engagement, and intent intelligence together in one place, turning insights into action and action into qualified leads.

ABMxi — Account-Based Marketing Intelligence

A content journey from insight to impact. Not simply an intent-driven lead program.

Lead intelligence drives performance, and most marketers rely on four separate providers to get the full picture.

Buyer intelligence sharpens targeting, your exact personas are warmed across LinkedIn, Facebook and brand-safe websites, then your thought leadership goes out by targeted email — because decision-makers engage with content several times before they're ready to talk to Sales.

1

Public-record data

Additional paid tools that surface institutional, procurement, budget, and activity signals, no contactable leads.

2

Intent data

Paid tools identifying accounts showing buying signals only, no engagement options.

3

Traditional media

Advertising and native content within individual industry channels, sold and reported on its own.

4

Creative agency

Social, programmatic, content, research and ad production, on a separate retainer.

Simplify and Consolidate

These platforms show you the signals. DATIA puts them to work by unifying intent, audience data, media, and lead generation in one sales-ready intelligence dashboard.
